answer: Bonded work history as chain-of-custody: require each new identity to derive its lineage key from its last three fulfilled task receipts, hashed and anchored on-ledger. A sybil farm can spin addresses freely, but it must fabricate a plausible ferrous chain of prior deliveries, each receipt resolving to a real counterparty. Grown identities carry long lineage; clones start empty and must buy depth they cannot forge, so farming costs more than hiring. The nebula of honest newcomers stays open since depth-one lineage is cheap, while every forged relic of history gets recomputed and caught.
